zh: 航空短訊彙整：美國航空籌辦珍珠港事件 85 週年紀念包機、ACI 公布機場創新獎，上海浦東與虹橋分獲兩項肯定、日本松山機場舉行空難應變演練
en: Aviation briefs: American Airlines plans Pearl Harbor anniversary charter; ACI names airport innovation winners, with awards for Shanghai Pudong and Hongqiao; Japan’s Matsuyama Airport holds aircraft emergency drill

zh: 選舉返鄉部分離島航班訂位近滿
en: Some island flights nearly fully booked amid election travel, Taiwan CAA says.

zh: 航空短訊彙整：Alliance Airlines執行長表示2026財年準點率達95%、美軍擬12月初恢復華盛頓國家機場附近直升機訓練飛行、K2 Aviation 簽約向 SMBC 購買六架波音 737-800
en: Aviation briefs: Alliance Airlines CEO reports 95% on-time rate for 2026 financial year; US Army moves to resume helicopter training flights near Washington National Airport; K2 Aviation agrees to buy six Boeing 737-800s from SMBC

zh: 鄭麗君：美對臺無人機關稅15%不疊加，優惠已上路
en: Taiwan says U.S. 15% non-stacking tariff on its drones is in force.

zh: 長榮航空獲7項永續獎，首獲全球企業永續獎報告書金獎
en: EVA Air wins seven sustainability awards, including its first report gold at the Global Corporate Sustainability Awards.

zh: 航空短訊彙整：FAA收緊全美Line Up and Wait規定 機場延誤恐增加、報導：五角大廈與通用汽車、福特汽車初步洽談軍用無人機零件供應、Virgin Atlantic擬2027年3月在曼徹斯特引進空中巴士A330neo
en: Aviation briefs: FAA Tightens Line Up and Wait Rules Nationwide; US Airport Delays May Rise; Pentagon in early talks with General Motors and Ford on military drone parts: report; Virgin Atlantic plans Airbus A330neo flights from Manchester in March 2027

zh: Western Global東京滑出跑道等4起獨立事件
en: Safety roundup: Four independent incidents include Western Global's Tokyo runway excursion.

zh: 航空短訊彙整：Boom首度運轉原型引擎核心 擬供Overture客機引擎使用、英國空軍司令：無人戰機預計明年在英國空域飛行、波音獲美國空軍合約 增造15架KC-46A Pegasus加油機
en: Aviation briefs: Boom runs prototype core intended for Overture engine for first time; RAF chief says uncrewed fighters expected to fly in UK airspace next year; Boeing wins U.S. Air Force contract to build 15 more KC-46A Pegasus tankers

zh: 長榮航太：2027年維修業務約8至9成已排定
en: Evergreen Aviation Technologies says roughly 80% to 90% of 2027 maintenance work is scheduled.

zh: 航空短訊彙整：波音未向工會說明後續是否裁員 737 MAX月產47架預期延至2027年初、波音埃弗里特 737 據報納入生產證書，仍待 FAA 完成稽核、新加坡航空開航西雪梨國際機場，首班由總理黃循財搭乘
en: Aviation briefs: Boeing declines to tell a union if more layoffs will follow; 737 MAX output target slips to 2027; Boeing’s Everett 737 line reportedly added to production certificate, FAA audit still underway; Singapore Airlines begins daily Western Sydney flights with PM Lawrence Wong on the first service
